page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6a.large is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs from an AMD EPYC 7H12 processor running at 2.6 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of RAM, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the instance delivers modest compute and memory performance. The AMD EPYC 7H12 processor achieves an average single-core Geekbench score of 1264.0, but its multi-core Geekbench score of 1594.0 and Passmark CPU score of 2789.36 fall into the bottom 10% of tested systems. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 99.72 GB/sec and an uncached large block write speed of 14.89 GB/sec, placing memory performance in the weak to poor categories.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.r6a.large is its low compute throughput relative to its memory capacity. While it offers a cost-efficient entry point for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high CPU performance, it is limited in processing-heavy tasks. The instance is suitable for small-scale databases, caching layers, and lightweight memory-bound applications that operate within a 1 Gbps network baseline.
